risks.proof: A short video: power on + show the display + press several keys + demonstrate sound through the built-in speaker (and/or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case: treat as needing testing/possible faults).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect power adapter or battery/charging issue (common with used keyboards).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact power adapter/charger model and the keyboard’s power input/port, plus a clip showing it powering on using that adapter.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming you may need to source/replace the correct adapter.

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage or wear not fully visible (scratches, broken knobs/buttons, speaker damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: speaker grille, all knobs/buttons, both ends, and the back panel/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming normal used wear and possible minor cosmetic issues.

risks.proof: Photo of the full model nameplate/serial sticker on the back (or underside) clearly showing 'PSR-550'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the stated model only if confirmed; otherwise treat as a generic Yamaha keyboard of similar class.

proof_requests: Video proof: power on + display visible + play several keys + show sound from speaker (and headphone if available).
Photo of the back panel/serial/model sticker clearly showing 'PSR-550'.
Photo of the exact power adapter/charger and the keyboard’s power input port.
Close-ups of all buttons/knobs and the speaker grille (front and any visible damage).
